questions.prompt: How do Flutter's Widget, Element, and RenderObject trees work together?

options.text: They are three copies of the same mutable class
RenderObjects are rebuilt from scratch on every frame
Widgets are immutable blueprints, Elements manage lifecycle/state and link trees, and RenderObjects handle layout and painting

questions.prompt: When reordering or removing items in a list of stateful widgets, why is `ValueKey(item.id)` required instead of no key or `UniqueKey()`?

options.text: No key matches by position so state stays on the wrong index; `UniqueKey()` forces full recreation on every rebuild

questions.prompt: Why is calling `context.read<Cart>()..add(item)` inside `build()` an anti-pattern, whereas `context.watch<Cart>()` is for `build()`?

options.text: `read()` throws in `build()` or fails to subscribe, and mutating state inside `build()` causes side effects on every frame

questions.prompt: Match each Flutter `Key` type to its behavior.

columns.label: Compares equal using `==` on the wrapped value
Always unique; forces widget/state recreation on every new instance

questions.prompt: Why should heavy JSON parsing or image processing use `Isolate.run(...)` / `compute(...)` in Flutter?

options.text: Dart has no `jsonDecode` on the main isolate
Flutter's UI and Dart event loop share the main isolate; blocking >16ms (at 60Hz) or >8ms (at 120Hz) causes frame jank

questions.prompt: Select all practices that prevent memory leaks and post-dispose crashes in Flutter `State` classes. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Store `BuildContext` in a global static variable
Check `if (!mounted) return;` after `await` before calling `setState` or using `context`

questions.prompt: What does `RepaintBoundary` achieve around a complex, frequently animating widget (like a custom chart or spinner)?

options.text: Converts it to an image file
Isolates its display list/layer so sibling static widgets don't have to repaint when it animates

questions.prompt: Why is `shrinkWrap: true` inside a `ListView` nested inside a `SingleChildScrollView` a performance trap for large lists?

options.text: `shrinkWrap: true` forces the `ListView` to lay out ALL its children eagerly to measure total height, defeating lazy building

questions.prompt: What is the benefit of `select` (e.g., `context.select((UserModel u) => u.name)`) over `watch`?

options.text: The widget only rebuilds when `u.name` changes, ignoring changes to other fields on `UserModel`

questions.prompt: When should you push `setState` down into a smaller child `StatefulWidget` instead of keeping it at the page `Scaffold`?

options.text: Never; keep all state at the top
When only a small part of the screen (like a countdown or toggle) updates frequently, avoiding rebuilding the whole page

questions.prompt: Select all practices that improve Flutter accessibility (a11y) and WCAG compliance. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Use `MergeSemantics` to combine related label+value rows into one screen-reader announcement
Ensure interactive targets are at least 48x48dp and have sufficient color contrast
Test with `Semantics` debugger / TalkBack / VoiceOver and large text-scale (`MediaQuery.textScalerOf`)

questions.prompt: What risk does `TextScaler` / large OS font scaling create if you hardcode `SizedBox(height: 40)` around text?

options.text: Larger accessibility font sizes overflow or clip inside fixed-height boxes

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of `flutter build appbundle` / `flutter build ipa` compared to `flutter run`?

options.text: Release builds use AOT compilation, tree-shaking, and strip debug/assert overhead for production size and speed

questions.prompt: Why should performance profiling in Flutter NEVER be measured in debug mode?

options.text: Debug mode uses JIT compilation, extra assertions, and service extensions that make frames artificially slow
DevTools only runs in debug mode
Debug mode runs on a single pixel

questions.prompt: Match each Flutter DevTools view to what it diagnoses.

columns.label: Inspect widget/render tree layout constraints and rebuilds
Identify UI-thread vs raster-thread jank (>16ms frames)
Track heap allocations and retained `State`/image objects

questions.prompt: What does `Opacity(opacity: 0.5, child: complexSubtree)` cost compared to animating `FadeTransition`?

options.text: `Opacity` may allocate an offscreen saveLayer on every frame if animated, whereas `FadeTransition` / `AnimatedOpacity` optimizes compositing

questions.prompt: Why is `Opacity(opacity: 0.0, child: ...)` often worse than `Visibility` or `Offstage` or omitting the widget?

options.text: `Opacity(0.0)` still paints or composites the subtree unless skipped, whereas omitting or `Visibility(visible: false)` avoids painting

questions.prompt: What does `flutter test --coverage` generate?

options.text: An `lcov.info` coverage report under `coverage/` for tracking tested code

questions.prompt: Select all valid testing layers in a well-structured Flutter test suite. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Running live production payment charges in every PR unit test
Unit tests for pure business logic, models, and repositories
Widget tests (`testWidgets`) for component rendering and user interactions with mocked dependencies
Golden tests (`matchesGoldenFile`) for catching unintended visual regressions

questions.prompt: How should you handle `Platform.isIOS` / `Platform.isAndroid` in a Flutter app that also targets Flutter Web?

options.text: Use `Theme.of(context).platform` or `defaultTargetPlatform` and `kIsWeb` from `foundation.dart`, because `dart:io` `Platform` throws on Web

questions.prompt: What does `--obfuscate --split-debug-info=build/symbols` do in `flutter build`?

options.text: Obfuscates Dart symbol names in the release binary while saving symbol maps to deobfuscate crash stack traces

questions.prompt: Match each Flutter Web/mobile build concern to its solution.

rows.label: API secrets needed by the app

columns.label: Resize assets and use `cacheWidth`/`cacheHeight` for thumbnails
Keep secrets on backend proxy; never hardcode in client Dart

questions.prompt: Why is `cacheWidth` / `cacheHeight` useful on `Image.asset` or `Image.network` for small thumbnails?

options.text: It tells the engine to decode the image at thumbnail resolution, saving significant GPU/bitmap memory

questions.prompt: What happens if an `InheritedWidget` or `Provider` is accessed from a `BuildContext` *above* the provider (e.g., the `Scaffold` body inside `MaterialApp` vs `showDialog`)?

options.text: `ProviderNotFoundException` / assertion error because `.of(context)` only searches *up* the ancestor tree
It creates a new provider automatically

questions.prompt: What does `AutomaticKeepAliveClientMixin` do for tabs inside a `TabBarView` or `PageView`?

options.text: Keeps off-screen tab `State` alive (such as scroll position and form inputs) when switching tabs

questions.prompt: Select all statements that are true about Flutter's `const` optimization and `build()` design. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Helper methods like `_buildHeader()` cannot be `const` and don't create separate `Element` rebuild boundaries
Helper methods always run on a background isolate
Keep `build()` methods fast, pure, and free of network/DB calls
Split large `build()` methods into smaller `const`-constructible `StatelessWidget` classes rather than helper methods

questions.prompt: What does `flutter_secure_storage` (Keychain / Keystore) solve compared to `shared_preferences`?

options.text: Encrypted storage for sensitive tokens/credentials rather than plain-text preferences

questions.prompt: In `WidgetTester`, why might `await tester.ensureVisible(button)` be needed before `tester.tap(button)`?

options.text: If `button` is scrolled off-screen inside a `ListView` or `SingleChildScrollView`, `tap` misses it unless scrolled into view first

questions.prompt: What does `ScrollController.addListener` require to avoid firing work on every single pixel of scroll?

options.text: Checking thresholds (`pixels >= maxScrollExtent - 200`) and guarding against duplicate in-flight pagination requests

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of `ErrorWidget.builder` in production Flutter apps?

options.text: To replace the red/grey debug error screen with a user-friendly fallback widget if a build error occurs

questions.prompt: Match each Flutter error handler to what it catches.

columns.label: Uncaught async errors outside the framework
Renders fallback UI when a widget's `build()` throws

questions.prompt: Why should `GlobalKey` be used sparingly in Flutter?

options.text: It is relatively expensive (global registry lookup) and can reparent state unexpectedly if misused; prefer `ValueKey` or callbacks

questions.prompt: Select all valid reasons to use `flutter_lints` / `very_good_analysis` in `analysis_options.yaml`. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Catches unawaited futures and missing `dispose()` patterns early
Keeps team code style consistent in CI with `flutter analyze`
Eliminates the need for widget tests

questions.prompt: What does the `use_build_context_synchronously` lint specifically warn about?

options.text: Using `BuildContext` after an `await` without checking `if (!context.mounted) return;`

questions.prompt: What is a common cause of 'jank' on the first time an animation plays in Flutter?

options.text: Shader compilation / pipeline warmup or decoding large uncached images synchronously on first display

questions.prompt: What does `WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) { ... })` do?

options.text: Schedules a callback to run once after the current frame finishes rendering

questions.prompt: When writing a Flutter package/plugin, what is the role of `flutter_platform_interface` / federated plugins?

options.text: Separating the Dart app-facing API from platform-specific implementations (Android, iOS, Web, Desktop)

questions.prompt: Select all practices that keep Flutter CI pipelines fast and reliable. (Select all that apply.)

options.text: Skip static analysis and tests before publishing store releases

questions.prompt: Why is separating domain models and API clients from Flutter UI widgets (`package:flutter`) beneficial?

options.text: Flutter widgets cannot import Dart classes
It reduces APK size to 0 bytes
Pure Dart domain/logic code can be unit-tested fast with `dart test` and reused across CLI/backend/apps

questions.prompt: What does `AnnotatedRegion<SystemUiOverlayStyle>` control?

options.text: OS status bar and navigation bar icon brightness/colors for a given screen

questions.prompt: Why should you avoid `dynamic` in JSON `fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json)` without safe casting/validation?

options.text: Missing keys or unexpected types from a backend API cause runtime `TypeError`s unless handled safely
